summary: Used the canonical user-story CSV to refine the worksheet command center into a clearer teacher-intent, setup, preview, review, and export workflow while preserving the JSON-first compiler and deterministic generation.

commands_run.notes: Passed with existing unrelated queue/state warnings.
Frontend/helper test file passed, including source-level guards for the story-driven UI changes.
Checked 139 worksheet types and 834 generated items; failed list was empty.
Next webpack build passed and prerendered route / as static content.

acceptance_results.notes: Added a workflow rail and retained the current draft summary in the desktop control deck.

acceptance_results.criterion: The preview is visually cleaner and resembles the final worksheet before digital checking controls are expanded

acceptance_results.criterion: Review and export actions are visible without forcing users to discover a hidden tab
acceptance_results.notes: Primary print/copy/make-another actions remain above trust-panel details, with Print student copy promoted.

acceptance_results.criterion: Mobile keeps a step workflow with concise labels and usable action placement
acceptance_results.notes: Mobile setup/preview/review/export tabs remain; mobile export panel state is synchronized with TrustPanel tabs.
